results.name: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press
instructions: Sit on an incline bench set at a 45-degree angle, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms bent and dumbbells positioned near your chest.
Press both dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended, keeping your palms facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control.
Repeat the pressing motion for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Ensure your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms.
Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the press to protect your joints.
Use a weight that allows for proper form and control.
results.description: Dumbbell Incline Bench Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Fly on Exercise Ball
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball and walk your feet forward until your middle back is supported on the ball, feet slightly wider than shoulder-width, hinge your hips to form a 90 degree angle with your torso.

Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms extended straight out to your sides at chest level, palms facing up. Bring the dumbbells up in a controlled manner, following a wide arc, until they meet above your chest.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back out to your sides in a wide arc until your arms are level with your chest.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, ensuring a controlled and steady motion throughout.
tips: Keep your back supported on the ball and your hips lowered to maintain a stable position.
Engage your core to stabilize your body and maintain proper form.
Exhale as you raise the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
results.description: Dumbbell Incline Fly on Exercise Ball is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Fly
instructions: Lie on an incline bench set at a 45-degree angle, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your arms extended straight out to your sides at chest level, palms facing up.
Engage your core and bring the dumbbells up in a controlled manner, following a wide arc, until they meet above your chest, maintaining a slight bend in your elbows.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back out to your sides in a wide arc until your arms are level with your chest.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you raise the dumbbells and inhale as you lower them.
Avoid locking your elbows; maintain a slight bend to protect your joints.
Ensure your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms.
results.description: Dumbbell Incline Fly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Press
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit back against it, holding a dumbbell in one hand at shoulder height with your palm facing forward. Your other arm can hold the bench for stability.
Press the dumbbell upward until your arm is fully extended above your upper chest.
Lower the dumbbell back to shoulder height with control, keeping your elbow at a 45-degree angle to your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions before switching to the other arm.
tips: Avoid locking your elbow at the top of the movement; maintain a slight bend.
Hold the bench edge with your free hand to support your body during the exercise.
Choose a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Palms Back Press
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit back against it, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height with elbows bent and facing the floor, with an underhand grip (palms facing back).
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended above your chest, maintaining the underhand grip.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height with control, keeping your elbows close to your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you press the dumbbells upward and inhale as you lower them.
Choose a weight that allows for proper form and control throughout the exercise.
Use a controlled motion, focusing on the muscles being worked.
results.description: Dumbbell Incline Palms Back Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Squeeze Press
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and lie back against it, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other. Position the dumbbells just above your chest, pressed together.
Press the dumbbells upward by extending your arms, keeping your elbows close to your torso.
Fully extend your arms at the top, ensuring the dumbbells remain in contact with each other.
Lower the dumbbells back to the starting position with control, keeping them squeezed together. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Squeeze the dumbbells together throughout the entire movement to maximize chest engagement.
Use a slow and controlled motion to maximize muscle engagement and avoid swinging.
Ensure your wrists remain straight and aligned with your forearms.
results.description: Dumbbell Incline Squeeze Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Svend Close Grip Press
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and lie back against it. Hold a single dumbbell pressed between your palms just above your chest with your fingers extended or interlaced around the handle.
Press the dumbbell upward by extending your arms, keeping your elbows close to your torso.
Fully extend your arms at the top, continuing to press the dumbbell between your palms.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position with control, keeping the dumbbell pressed between your palms. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Exhale as you press the dumbbell upward and inhale as you lower it.
Avoid locking your elbows at the top of the movement to maintain tension on the muscles.
Choose a weight that allows you to maintain proper form and control throughout the exercise.
results.description: Dumbbell Incline Svend Close Grip Press is an intermediate multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps.

results.name: Dumbbell Incline Twisted Fly
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and lie back against it, holding a dumbbell in each hand. Start with your arms extended lightly bent by your sides, palms facing up, dumbbells held at chest level.
Raise the dumbbells up over your chest in a wide arc, rotating your palms so they face backwards as you raise them up.
Reverse the motion, bringing the dumbbells back down in a wide arc and rotating your palms back to face upward. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Maintain a slight bend in your elbows throughout the movement to reduce joint strain.
Use a slow and controlled motion to maximize muscle engagement.
Avoid letting the dumbbells touch at the top to maintain tension on the muscles.
results.description: Dumbbell Incline Twisted Fly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Front Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell Lying on Floor Chest Press
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with knees bent, holding a dumbbell in each hand above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells until your upper arms touch the floor, elbows at about 45 degrees.
Pause briefly.
Press the dumbbells back up and repeat.
tips: The floor limits the range, which is easier on the shoulders.
Don't bounce your elbows off the floor.
results.description: Dumbbell Lying on Floor Chest Press is a beginner multi-joint compound pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Triceps, Front Shoulders.

results.name: Dumbbell One Arm Floor Fly
instructions: Lie on your back on the floor with your legs straight. Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your arm slightly bent on the floor, palm facing up. Keep your free hand on the floor for support.
Slowly raise your arm over your chest in a wide arc motion, keeping a slight bend in your elbow.
Lower the dumbbell back to the starting position until your arm nearly touches the floor.
Repeat for the desired repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
tips: Keep a slight bend in your elbow to reduce strain on your joint.
Avoid letting your back arch off the floor; keep it flat and supported.
Focus on using your chest muscles to lift the dumbbell, minimizing shoulder involvement.
results.description: Dumbbell One Arm Floor Fly is an intermediate single-joint isolation pushing exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a dumbbell, it falls under the strength category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders.
